# Dorrit Ravnham

Dorrit Ravnham is a Legal Tech Product Manager currently at Tesstun Works, a leading AI-powered platform specializing in automating clause extraction and redlining for procurement teams. Since joining Tesstun Works in 2021, Dorrit has overseen the product roadmap for their flagship contract lifecycle management solutions, driving innovation to streamline procurement review processes for enterprise clients.

Dorrit began her career in 2014 at Contractica, where she played a pivotal role in launching ClauseSense, an advanced redlining tool designed to accelerate negotiation cycles. Her experience there sharpened her expertise in integrating AI capabilities with user-friendly contract automation workflows. Between 2014 and 2021, she held progressively senior roles focusing on contract analytics and automation technologies.

Her specialties include guiding cross-functional teams in developing scalable contract lifecycle management products, with a strong emphasis on AI-driven clause extraction and collaborative redlining features. Notable projects under her leadership at Tesstun Works include “Project Atlas,” an initiative to enhance multi-party contract collaboration, and “Codex,” designed to improve procurement risk scoring through machine learning insights.

Dorrit is known for her data-driven, iterative working style and typically partners closely with data scientists, UX designers, and procurement domain experts to align product development with evolving market needs.

Current employer: [[companies/tesstun-works]].
